info.name: OpenCitations Index REST Authors Metadata API

params.name: ids
params.description: One or more bibliographic entity IDs separated by "__". Supported prefixes: doi, issn, isbn, omid, openalex, pmid, pmcid.

params.name: require
params.description: Removes rows with empty values in the specified field

params.name: filter
params.description: Applies conditional filtering. Supports regex or operators (=, <, >). Format: field:operator:value. Example: date:>2015

params.name: sort
params.description: Orders results by field in ascending or descending order. Format: asc(field) or desc(field).

params.name: json
params.description: Transforms JSON data structure. Supports array splitting or dict conversion.

items.docs:
Retrieves the bibliographic metadata for each of the bibliographic entities identified by one or more input IDs.
Each ID is built as follows: ID abbreviation + ":" + ID value. For example, "doi:10.3233/ds-170012" indicates a DOI identifier with value "10.3233/ds-170012".
Supported ID abbreviations: doi, issn, isbn, omid, openalex, pmid, pmcid.
Multiple IDs can be specified separated with double underscore "__". Example: doi:10.1108/jd-12-2013-0166__doi:10.1016/j.websem.2012.08.001
